blurb.en: Listen to two friends chatting, and find out what happened, what they think and what they will do.
blurb.vi: Nghe hai bạn trò chuyện, rồi tìm ra chuyện gì đã xảy ra, các bạn nghĩ gì và sẽ làm gì.

title.vi: Từ làm thay đổi đáp án

prefer.def: To like one thing more than another thing.
prefer.ex: I *prefer* apples to bananas because they are crunchy.

the best part.def: The bit of something that you liked the most.
the best part.ex: *The best part* of the trip was the boat ride.

enjoy.def: To like doing something and have a good time.
enjoy.ex: We *enjoy* playing games in the park after school.

boring.def: Not interesting at all, so you want it to finish.
boring.ex: The film was so *boring* that I fell asleep.

I'm not keen on.def: A polite way to say you do not like something very much.
I'm not keen on.ex: *I'm not keen on* fish, so I had chicken.

actually.def: We say this before the true fact, often when someone guessed wrong.
actually.ex: You think I'm ten? *Actually*, I'm nine.

instead.def: In the place of another thing or another plan.
instead.ex: The park was closed, so we went to the library *instead*.

in the end.def: What finally happened, after some changes or some thinking.
in the end.ex: We looked at three cakes, and *in the end* we chose the lemon one.

change your mind.def: To make a new choice that is different from your first one.
change your mind.ex: I wanted the red bag, but then I *changed my mind*.

was going to.def: Shows an old plan from before. Often it did not happen.
was going to.ex: We *were going to* play tennis, but it rained.

guess.def: To say an answer when you are not sure it is right.
guess.ex: Mum tried to *guess* what was in the box.

reason.def: Why something happens, or why someone does something.
reason.ex: The *reason* I'm late is that the bus broke down.

plan.def: Something you have decided to do later.
plan.ex: Our *plan* for Sunday is to visit Grandpa.

decide.def: To choose what to do after you think about it.
decide.ex: We couldn't *decide* between pizza and noodles.

scenes.head: Listen to Kenji and Wren.
scenes.html:
Kenji: Wren, what did you eat at the school fair?
Wren: Well, *I wanted noodles first*. And Mum said, *try the soup*!
Kenji: So did you have the soup?
Wren: No, I'm not keen on soup. And the noodles were all sold out. So *in the end*, I had *rice and chicken*. It was really good.

audio.head: Listen to Kenji and Wren.
lines: Wren, what did you eat at the school fair?
Well, I wanted noodles first. And Mum said, try the soup!
So did you have the soup?
No, I'm not keen on soup. And the noodles were all sold out. So in the end, I had rice and chicken. It was really good.

steps.en: In a conversation test, all three options are usually *said* in the talk.
steps.vi: Trong bài nghe hội thoại, cả ba lựa chọn thường đều được *nói* ra.

steps.en: Wren talks about noodles, soup and rice. Only one is what she ate.
steps.vi: Wren nói về mì, súp và cơm. Chỉ một món là bạn ấy đã ăn.

steps.en: Listen for *in the end*. The real answer often comes after it.
steps.vi: Hãy nghe cụm *in the end*. Đáp án thật thường đến ngay sau đó.

title.en: What they liked and did not like
title.vi: Điều các bạn thích và không thích

scenes.head: Listen to Dan and Pia.
scenes.html:
Dan: Pia, did you enjoy the space centre?
Pia: Yes! *The best part* was the star show. The ceiling turned into the night sky. I didn't know Saturn had so many moons!
Dan: What about the rocket models?
Pia: They were *a bit boring*. And the ice creams in the café were *too expensive*. But I'd like to go back and see the star show again.

audio.head: Listen to Dan and Pia.
lines: Pia, did you enjoy the space centre?
Yes! The best part was the star show. The ceiling turned into the night sky. I didn't know Saturn had so many moons!
They were a bit boring. And the ice creams in the café were too expensive. But I'd like to go back and see the star show again.

steps.en: Questions often ask what someone liked *best* or did *not* like.
steps.vi: Câu hỏi thường hỏi ai đó thích điều gì *nhất* hoặc *không* thích điều gì.

steps.en: *The best part* tells you what Pia liked most.
steps.vi: *The best part* cho em biết điều Pia thích nhất.

steps.en: *Boring* and *too expensive* tell you what she did not like.
steps.vi: *Boring* và *too expensive* cho em biết điều bạn ấy không thích.

scenes.head: Listen to Eva and Noah.
scenes.html:
Eva: Noah, why weren't you at football club yesterday?
Noah: I had *a sore throat and a runny nose*. And I *couldn't stop sneezing*!
Eva: Oh no. So your mum said you had to *stay at home*?
Noah: Yes. I feel much better today, though. I'm going to the club on Friday.

audio.head: Listen to Eva and Noah.
lines: Noah, why weren't you at football club yesterday?
I had a sore throat and a runny nose. And I couldn't stop sneezing!
Oh no. So your mum said you had to stay at home?
Yes. I feel much better today, though. I'm going to the club on Friday.

steps.en: The options often use *different words* from the talk.
steps.vi: Các lựa chọn thường dùng *từ khác* với bài nghe.

steps.en: Noah never says *ill* or *a cold*. But a sore throat, a runny nose and sneezing tell us he had a cold.
steps.vi: Noah không nói *ill* hay *a cold*. Nhưng đau họng, sổ mũi và hắt hơi cho ta biết bạn ấy bị cảm.

steps.en: Match the *meaning*, not just a word you hear.
steps.vi: Hãy chọn theo *ý nghĩa*, không chỉ theo một từ em nghe thấy.

end.en: Great listening! You found the real answer, not just a word you heard.
end.vi: Nghe rất giỏi! Em đã tìm ra đáp án thật, không chỉ một từ em nghe thấy.

challenge.result: You found the real answers after the wrong guesses and the old plans.

v.q: Who did Vy go to the night market with?
whys: Huy guesses her sister, but Vy says her sister was at her dance class.
Grandma wanted to come, but she was too tired.
v.hint: Huy guesses first. Listen to what Vy says after *No*.
v.worked: Vy says "*I went with my aunt and my cousin*".

stim.head: Listen to Huy and Vy.
lines: Vy, I saw you at the night market on Saturday. Were you with your sister?
No, my sister was at her dance class. I went with my aunt and my cousin.
Didn't your grandma want to come?
She did, but she was too tired. We brought her some sweet potatoes.

v.q: Who is Noah's hero?
whys: Freya guesses a footballer, but Noah says "no".
Noah says his coach is great, but he isn't the one Noah will write about.
v.hint: Two people are ruled out first. Listen for who is left.
v.worked: Noah says "*My grandma!* She learned to swim when she was sixty".

stim.head: Listen to Freya and Noah.
lines: Noah, who are you going to write about for 'My hero'? A famous footballer?
I like footballers, but no. And not my football coach, although he's great.
My grandma! She learned to swim when she was sixty. Now she swims every morning.

v.q: When is Eva's birthday party?
whys: The party was going to be on Saturday, but Dad has to work then.
Friday is Eva's birthday, but they are only having a cake at home.
v.hint: Listen for *was going to*. It tells you the old plan, so keep listening for the new one.
v.worked: Eva says "*the party is on Sunday afternoon*".

stim.head: Listen to Oscar and Eva.
lines: Eva, is your birthday party on Saturday?
It was going to be, but Dad has to work on Saturday. So the party is on Sunday afternoon.
But isn't your birthday on Friday?
Yes, it is. On Friday we're just having a cake at home.

v.q: When is Kenji going to the dentist?
whys: The dentist had nothing this afternoon.
Thursday was the first time they offered, but then it changed.
v.hint: Three times are said. Listen for what happened when somebody cancelled.
v.worked: Kenji says "*I'm going tomorrow morning at nine*".

lines: Kenji, is your tooth still hurting?
Yes. Mum phoned the dentist this morning. They had nothing this afternoon.
So are you going on Thursday?
That was the first time they offered. But then somebody cancelled, so I'm going tomorrow morning at nine.

v.q: Why didn't Wren eat any pizza?
whys: The pizza was a bit cold, but Wren says "that wasn't the problem".
Wren says "I love mushrooms!"
v.hint: Dan makes two guesses. Check what Wren says about each one.
v.worked: Wren says "*I had a stomach ache* all afternoon".

stim.head: Listen to Dan and Wren.
lines: Wren, why didn't you eat any pizza at the party? Was it cold?
It was a bit cold, but that wasn't the problem.
I love mushrooms! No, I had a stomach ache all afternoon. I only had some water.

v.q: Why does Pia like her new flat?
opts: It's bigger than her old flat.
whys: Pia says the new flat is smaller, not bigger.
Pia says it's further from school, not closer.
v.hint: The reason often comes after *because*.
v.worked: Pia says "*Because the park is right next to it!*"

lines: Pia, do you like your new flat? Is it bigger than your old one?
No, it's smaller, actually. And it's further from school, so I get up earlier.
So why do you like it?
Because the park is right next to it! I play there every evening.

v.q: What did Oscar NOT like at the festival?
whys: Oscar says the lion dance was amazing.
Oscar says the food was delicious.
v.hint: The question says NOT. Find the thing Oscar had a problem with.
v.worked: Oscar says the fireworks "*were too loud for me*".

stim.head: Listen to Vy and Oscar.
lines: Oscar, did you enjoy the New Year festival?
Mostly! The lion dance was amazing, and the food was delicious.
And the fireworks? They were beautiful!
They were too loud for me. I covered my ears the whole time.

v.q: What are Freya and Dan going to do after school?
whys: The tennis courts are closed today.
Freya hasn't got any money for the cinema.
v.hint: Dan has two ideas. Listen to Freya's answer to each one.
v.worked: Freya says "*Let's make pancakes at my house*", and Dan says "OK, great idea!"

lines: Freya, shall we play tennis after school?
We can't. The courts are closed today.

blurb.vi: Nghe các đoạn hội thoại ngắn và trả lời một câu hỏi mỗi lần.

title.vi: Thông tin: ai, khi nào, ở đâu

v.q: Who took Dan to the hospital?
whys: Dan's mum was at work in another town, so she didn't take him.
His teacher saw him fall and phoned his mum, but she didn't take him.
v.hint: Three people are in the story. Check what each person really did.
v.worked: Dan says "*My uncle* lives near the school, *so he came and took me*".

stim.head: Listen to Eva and Dan.
lines: Dan, what happened to your arm?
I fell over in the playground on Friday. My teacher saw me, and she phoned my mum.
Did your mum take you to the hospital?
No, she was at work in another town. My uncle lives near the school, so he came and took me. It isn't broken, just a bit swollen.

v.q: Who is going to teach Pia to swim?
whys: Pia says her dad is too busy at the moment.
The lessons at the pool near school are full.
v.hint: Listen for *was going to*: that plan did not happen.
v.worked: Pia says "*my cousin is going to teach me*".

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Pia.
lines: Pia, are you having swimming lessons this summer?
Yes! I was going to have lessons at the pool near school, but they're full.
Can your dad teach you? He swims every week.
He's too busy at the moment. So my cousin is going to teach me. She's sixteen, and she's a really good swimmer.

v.q: What time does the cooking club start?
whys: Three o'clock is when school finishes, not when the club starts.
Half past four is when the club finishes.
v.hint: Wren guesses a time. Listen to Oscar's answer after *No*.
v.worked: Oscar says "*it starts at half past three*".

stim.head: Listen to Oscar and Wren.
lines: Wren, are you coming to the new cooking club on Tuesday?
Yes! Does it start at three o'clock, when school finishes?
No. The teacher needs time to get the kitchen ready. So it starts at half past three.
At half past four. So it's one hour.

v.q: When is the class trip to the museum?
whys: Tuesday was the first plan, but the museum is closed on Tuesdays.
Freya has a dentist appointment next Friday. That isn't the trip.
v.hint: Listen for *first plan*. Then listen for *now*.
v.worked: Huy says "*now it's next Thursday*".

stim.head: Listen to Freya and Huy.
lines: Huy, is our class trip to the history museum next Tuesday?
That was the first plan. But the museum is closed on Tuesdays. So now it's next Thursday.
Oh good! I've got a dentist appointment next Friday, so I was worried.
Don't worry. You won't miss it.

v.q: Where did Noah buy the pineapples?
whys: Noah says the pineapples were really expensive at the supermarket.
The fruit shop near school was closed.
v.hint: Vy makes a guess. Listen to Noah's answer.
v.worked: Noah says "*Mum and I went to the market by the river*".

stim.head: Listen to Vy and Noah.
lines: Noah, these pineapples are lovely. Did you buy them at the supermarket?
No, they were really expensive there. And the fruit shop near our school was closed.
So where did you get them?
Mum and I went to the market by the river. They were much cheaper there, and they're sweeter too.

v.q: Where was Pia's water bottle?
whys: Pia looked everywhere in the classroom, but it wasn't there.
The driver checked the bus, but it wasn't there.
v.hint: Pia looked in two places first. Where was it really?
v.worked: Pia says "*It was in the music room*, under the piano!"

stim.head: Listen to Huy and Pia.
lines: Pia, did you find your water bottle?
Yes, finally! I looked everywhere in our classroom. Then I thought I left it on the school bus.
No, the driver checked. It was in the music room, under the piano! I had it in my music lesson.

title.vi: Thích, không thích và lý do

v.q: What was the best part of the farm trip for Freya?
whys: The strawberries were tasty, but Freya's back hurt afterwards.
Freya says the tractor was very slow and noisy.
v.hint: Listen for the words *the best part*.
v.worked: Freya says "We fed the baby goats. *That was the best part*".

stim.head: Listen to Noah and Freya.
lines: How was the farm trip, Freya?
Great! First we picked strawberries. They were tasty, but my back hurt afterwards!
We fed the baby goats. That was the best part. They were so funny and friendly.
Did you ride on the tractor too?
Only for five minutes. It was very slow and noisy.

v.q: What did Dan like best at the festival?
whys: Dan's little sister loved the face painting. Dan didn't do it.
Dan says the dance show was OK, but really long.
v.hint: *The best thing* means the same as *the best part*. Listen for it.
v.worked: Dan says "*The magic show was the best thing*".

stim.head: Listen to Vy and Dan.
lines: Did you go to the Children's Day festival in the park, Dan?
Yes! My little sister loved the face painting. I didn't do it. I'm too old for that!
It was OK, but it was really long. The magic show was the best thing. The magician made a bird come out of my hat!

v.q: What did Eva NOT like about the new café?
whys: Eva says the cakes are delicious.
Eva says the fruit drinks are cheap, so that is a good thing.
v.hint: The question says NOT. Listen after *But* for the problem.
v.worked: Eva says "*the music was so loud!* We couldn't hear each other".

stim.head: Listen to Oscar and Eva.
lines: Eva, have you been to the new café on Green Street?
Yes, on Sunday with my mum. The cakes are delicious, and the fruit drinks are cheap.
Mostly. But the music was so loud! We couldn't hear each other. I'd like to go back, but I'll sit outside next time.

v.q: What did Huy NOT enjoy at the party?
whys: Huy says the games were fun.
Huy says the pizza was great.
v.hint: The question says NOT. Which thing made Huy scared?
v.worked: Huy says the wall was really high and "*I didn't enjoy that bit at all*".

stim.head: Listen to Wren and Huy.
lines: How was the party at the climbing centre, Huy?
The games were fun, and the pizza was great.
And the climbing? You love climbing!
I usually do. But the wall was really high, and I got scared at the top. I came down very quickly. I didn't enjoy that bit at all.

v.q: Why is Eva worried?
whys: Eva says she is good at maths, so the test isn't the problem.
Eva says she and Pia aren't angry with each other any more.
v.hint: Kenji guesses first. Listen for *So what's wrong?*
v.worked: Eva says "*It's my cat.* She won't eat anything".

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Eva.
lines: Eva, you look worried. Is it the maths test tomorrow?
No, I'm good at maths. And it isn't Pia. We aren't angry with each other any more.
It's my cat. She won't eat anything, and she sleeps all day. Dad's taking her to the vet after school.

v.q: Why did Noah go to the doctor?
whys: Noah had a sore throat last month, not now.
His sister has a stomach ache, not Noah.
v.hint: Some problems belong to another time or another person. Find Noah's problem today.
v.worked: Noah says "*I've had a bad cough for a week*".

stim.head: Listen to Pia and Noah.
lines: Noah, why weren't you at school this morning?
I went to the doctor. I've had a bad cough for a week, and it got worse at night.
Oh no. My mum said you had a sore throat.
That was last month. And my sister has a stomach ache today, but she didn't come with me. The doctor gave me some medicine.

title.vi: Cảm xúc, con người và kế hoạch tiếp theo

v.q: How did Wren feel before her concert?
whys: Wren felt proud when she finished, not before.
Her brother was excited, not Wren.
v.hint: Listen for *before*. How do shaking hands make you feel?
v.worked: Wren says "*before it started, my hands were shaking, and I felt a bit sick*". She was nervous.

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Wren.
lines: Wren, how was your piano concert?
It went well, thanks! But before it started, my hands were shaking, and I felt a bit sick.
Not that day! My brother was excited for me, but I just wanted to go home. When I finished, I felt really proud.

v.q: How does Huy feel about his new school now?
whys: Vy asks if he feels lonely, and Huy says "Not now".
Huy was worried on the first day, but not now.
v.hint: The question says *now*. Don't stop at the first day.
v.worked: Huy says "*I'm really happy there now*".

lines: On the first day I was worried, because I didn't know anyone. And the building is enormous! I got lost twice.
Not now. Everyone is really friendly, and I've joined the chess club. I'm really happy there now.

v.q: What is Kenji going to do on Saturday?
whys: The next football match is in two weeks, not this Saturday.
Kenji usually visits his grandma, but she's on holiday.
v.hint: Freya makes two guesses. Is Kenji's answer yes or no each time?
v.worked: Kenji says "*I'm helping at the animal shelter* with my dad".

stim.head: Listen to Freya and Kenji.
lines: Are you playing football on Saturday, Kenji?
Not this week. The next match is in two weeks.
So are you visiting your grandma?
I usually do, but she's on holiday. So I'm helping at the animal shelter with my dad. We're going to walk the dogs and clean the cages.

whys: The teacher said no sweets or chocolate.

lines: Oscar, what are you bringing to the class party on Friday?
I wanted to bring chocolate biscuits, but our teacher said no sweets or chocolate.
Lots of people are bringing pizza. So I'm bringing a big bag of oranges from my grandpa's garden. They're really juicy.

v.q: What is Noah's grandma like?
whys: Eva's grandma is shy, not Noah's.
Noah says his grandma is never bad-tempered.
v.hint: Two grandmas are in this talk. Make sure you choose Noah's.
v.worked: Noah says "*She talks all the time!* She tells stories at breakfast, at lunch and at dinner".

stim.head: Listen to Eva and Noah.
lines: Is your grandma staying with you, Noah?
Yes, for a month. She talks all the time! She tells stories at breakfast, at lunch and at dinner.
My grandma is quite shy. She hardly speaks to visitors.
Mine is the opposite! And she's never bad-tempered, even when my little brother is noisy.

v.q: Why does Dan say his brother is generous?
opts: He spent his money on Dan.

Dan says his brother is too busy to help with homework.

Yes! My brother bought it for me with his birthday money. He's really generous.
That's kind. Does he lend you his bike too?

title.vi: Phần 3: thông tin trong bài nghe

v.q: Who did Oscar go to the village with?
whys: His cousin was going to come, but she had a cold.
Oscar's mum had to work, so she didn't go.

v.worked: Oscar says "*I just went with my dad*".

stim.head: Listen to Pia and Oscar talking about Oscar's weekend in a village.
lines: Hi, Oscar. Did you have a good weekend?
Yes, thanks. I went to my grandparents' village. My cousin was going to come with us, but she had a cold. And Mum had to work. So I just went with my dad.
Very quiet. There used to be a big market there, and lots of shops. Grandpa says it was really busy when he was young. But now there's only one small shop.
So what did you do there?
Grandma wanted to show me her old school, but it was closed. So we went fishing in the river instead. I caught two fish!
Yes! Grandma cooked them for dinner with some rice. They were delicious.
Well done! Are you going back soon?
In the summer holiday. Next time, I want to help Grandpa on his farm. He grows rice and vegetables.

Yes, thanks. I went to my grandparents' village. My cousin was going to come with us, but she had a cold. And Mum had to work. So I just went with my dad.
Very quiet. There used to be a big market there, and lots of shops. Grandpa says it was really busy when he was young. But now there's only one small shop.
So what did you do there?
Grandma wanted to show me her old school, but it was closed. So we went fishing in the river instead. I caught two fish!
Yes! Grandma cooked them for dinner with some rice. They were delicious.
Well done! Are you going back soon?
In the summer holiday. Next time, I want to help Grandpa on his farm. He grows rice and vegetables.

lines: Vy, is your family ready for Tet?
Nearly! Yesterday we cleaned the whole flat. It took all day.
Did you buy a peach tree, like last year?

Dad wanted one, but they were too expensive this year. Mum liked some big yellow flowers at the market, but they were too big for our flat. So in the end we bought a small kumquat tree. It's got lots of little orange fruit on it.
Nice. What's your favourite thing about Tet? The lucky money?
Everyone thinks that! The lucky money is nice, but I love the food more. Grandma makes banh chung. It's soft and a bit chewy, and it's delicious. I could eat it every day!
Yes, on the second day of Tet. They live in a village near the sea. But tomorrow morning I'm helping Dad hang the decorations.

v.q: Why didn't Huy's class make smoothies?

stim.head: Listen to Eva and Huy talking about Healthy Food Week at school.
lines: Huy, did you go to the food stalls in the hall today?
Yes! It's Healthy Food Week, so every class made something. My class made fruit salad.
Fruit salad? I thought you wanted to make smoothies.
We did, but the school blender was broken. Some people wanted pancakes, but the teacher said they had too much sugar. So fruit salad was the best idea.
What did you try at the other stalls?
I had some rice cakes and some vegetable soup. The rice cakes were OK, but the soup was the best thing. It had carrots and beans in it.
Did you try the fish balls from Class 4B?

Yes. They were too salty for me. Next week we're making a poster about the food plate. My friend is drawing the fruit and vegetables, and another boy is doing the grains. I'm drawing the dairy part: milk, cheese and yoghurt.

stim.head: Listen to Dan and Freya talking about why Freya missed a class trip.
lines: Freya! You weren't at school yesterday. We missed you on the trip to the zoo.
I know. I was really sad. On Monday I had a headache. Mum thought I was just tired, or I needed more water. But then I got a fever in the night, and the doctor said it was flu.
Poor you. Were you bored at home?
At first, yes. I couldn't watch TV, because my eyes hurt. Mum brought me water and soup. But the nicest thing was my brother. He read me a story for an hour! He's usually quite selfish.
Ha! Well, the zoo was great. The best part was the elephants. But the penguins weren't there. That part of the zoo was closed.
Don't worry. Our teacher says we're going to the aquarium next month. There are penguins there too.

items.en: In a conversation test, all three options are usually *said* in the talk. Don't choose an option just because you hear it.
items.vi: Trong bài nghe hội thoại, cả ba lựa chọn thường đều được *nói* ra. Đừng chọn một đáp án chỉ vì em nghe thấy nó.
example: Question: What did Wren eat? (noodles / soup / rice)
Wren: I wanted noodles, and Mum said try the soup. *In the end* I had *rice*.

items.en: Listen for words that *change* the answer: *but*, *actually*, *instead*, *in the end*, *so*.
items.vi: Hãy nghe những từ *làm thay đổi* đáp án: *but*, *actually*, *instead*, *in the end*, *so*.
example: The courts were closed, *so* we went swimming *instead*.
You think it's on Monday? *Actually*, it's on Tuesday.

items.en: *Was going to* tells you an old plan. Keep listening for the new plan.
items.vi: *Was going to* cho em biết một kế hoạch cũ. Hãy nghe tiếp để biết kế hoạch mới.
example: I *was going to* buy a game, but now I'm saving for a bike.
We *were going to* eat at home, but we had a picnic.

items.en: Learn the words for likes and dislikes: *the best part*, *my favourite*, *I'm not keen on*, *boring*, *the worst part*.
items.vi: Học các từ chỉ điều thích và không thích: *the best part*, *my favourite*, *I'm not keen on*, *boring*, *the worst part*.
example: *The best part* was the goats. (= what I liked most)
*The worst part* was the smell. (= what I didn't like)

items.en: The *reason* often comes after *because*, or before *so*.
items.vi: *Lý do* thường đứng sau *because*, hoặc đứng trước *so*.
example: I like my flat *because* the park is next to it.
The museum is closed on Tuesdays, *so* we're going on Thursday.

items.en: The options often use *different words* from the talk. Match the *meaning*, and check *who* said or did it.
items.vi: Các lựa chọn thường dùng *từ khác* với bài nghe. Hãy chọn theo *ý nghĩa* và kiểm tra *ai* đã nói hoặc làm điều đó.
example: Talk: *My hands were shaking.* Option: *She was nervous.*
Talk: *My sister has a stomach ache.* So it's the sister, not the speaker.

check.sentence: In this test, the wrong options are {usually|never|not} said in the talk.
The park was closed, so we went to the library {instead|because|also}.
I {was going to|am going to|go to} visit Grandma, but she was ill.
We stayed inside {because|so|but} it was raining.
"My hands were shaking" means I was {nervous|bored|proud}.

v.q: Where did Huy have his birthday party?
whys: The party was going to be at home, but the kitchen is being painted.
Huy had a party at the sports centre last year, not this year.
v.hint: Listen for *instead*. It tells you the new plan.
v.worked: Huy says "*we had a picnic by the lake instead*".

stim.head: Listen to Freya and Huy talking about Huy's birthday.
lines: Happy birthday for yesterday, Huy! Did you have a party at the sports centre, like last year?
No. We were going to have a party at home this year, but our kitchen is being painted. So we had a picnic by the lake instead.
My parents, my grandpa and my two best friends from football. My sister didn't come, because she had a dance show.
Mum made chicken sandwiches and a big bowl of fruit. And there was a chocolate cake, of course. But Grandpa forgot the candles, so we sang without them!
Ha! What was your best present?
I got a football and some books. But my favourite was a small camera from Grandpa. I took photos of the ducks on the lake.
Did you get any birthday money?
Yes. I was going to buy a computer game, but my old bike is too small for me now. So I'm saving for a new bike.
Good idea. Are you going to buy more books too?
No, I've got lots of books now!

v.q: When did Vy go to the library?

v.worked: Vy says "*Actually, we went on Sunday*".

stim.head: Listen to Noah and Vy talking about the new library.
lines: Vy, how was the new library? You went on Saturday, didn't you?
Actually, we went on Sunday. On Saturday it was too busy. It's enormous! There are three floors.
The children's floor is at the top. There's a room where you can make things with paper, and a little cinema. But my favourite part was the reading garden on the roof. It's so quiet and green.
Yes. I wanted some books about space, but they were too difficult for me. So I borrowed two books about dinosaurs. My brother borrowed some comics.
Can you keep them for two weeks?
No, for three weeks! At our school library it's only one week.
That's good. Can I come with you next time?
Sure! I'm going again next Saturday. There's a storytelling afternoon at three o'clock. There's a puppet show too, but that's in the morning, and I've got my piano lesson then.

lines: Vy, how was the new library? You went on Saturday, didn't you?

Sure! I'm going again next Saturday. There's a storytelling afternoon at three o'clock. There's a puppet show too, but that's in the morning, and I've got my piano lesson then.
